user.title: Connect to Virtual Carillon
user.description: Enter the engine address. If the engine has an API token, enter the same token here. Choose the LitCal calendar that Automatic routines will use; you can change it later.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Virtual Carillon engine.

abort.already_configured: This Virtual Carillon engine is already configured.

init.title: Virtual Carillon schedules
init.description: Set the overall schedule and LitCal calendar, configure Westminster Chimes, and add routines. Manual plays one exact asset, Category chooses a hymn from selected categories, and Automatic chooses a hymn from the liturgical calendar.

global.title: Settings
global.description: Enable or disable all saved schedules, select the LitCal calendar for Automatic routines, and choose the Home Assistant playback distance.

westminster.title: Westminster Chimes
westminster.description: Choose the cadence, days, optional daily window, volume, and media players. At the hour, Virtual Carillon plays the full Westminster sequence and the correct count of hour strikes.

add_routine.title: Choose schedule mode
add_routine.description: Manual plays one specific asset or hymn. Category chooses a hymn from selected categories. Automatic uses the selected LitCal calendar to choose a hymn for the day.

add_routine_manual.title: Configure Manual playback
add_routine_manual.description: Choose the exact asset or hymn to play, then set its times, days, media players, optional window, and volume.

add_routine_category.title: Configure Category playback
add_routine_category.description: Choose one or more hymn categories, then set the times, days, media players, optional window, and volume.

add_routine_automatic.title: Configure Automatic playback
add_routine_automatic.description: Automatic mode uses the date’s LitCal context. The canonical-hour setting is a preference for selecting a hymn; it does not set the routine’s time.

edit_routine_mode.title: Choose schedule mode
edit_routine_mode.description: Manual plays one specific asset or hymn. Category chooses a hymn from selected categories. Automatic uses the selected LitCal calendar to choose a hymn for the day.

edit_routine_manual.title: Edit Manual playback
edit_routine_manual.description: Change the selected asset or hymn, times, days, media players, optional window, or volume.

edit_routine_category.title: Edit Category playback
edit_routine_category.description: Change the hymn categories, times, days, media players, optional window, or volume.

edit_routine_automatic.title: Edit Automatic playback
edit_routine_automatic.description: Automatic mode uses the date’s LitCal context. The canonical-hour setting is a preference for selecting a hymn; it does not set the routine’s time.

error.asset_required: Choose an asset or hymn for Manual mode.
error.category_required: Choose at least one hymn category for Category mode.
error.invalid_times: Enter one or more times in HH:MM format, separated by commas.
error.media_players_required: Select at least one Home Assistant media player.

abort.cannot_connect: The schedule could not be saved to Virtual Carillon.

play.name: Play an asset
play.description: Render and play one named Virtual Carillon asset through the selected media players.

asset.name: Asset
asset.description: The stable asset ID to play, such as angelus or salve-regina.

stop.name: Stop playback
stop.description: Stop the selected Home Assistant media players.

select_hymn.name: Select and play a hymn
select_hymn.description: Select a hymn using the configured LitCal calendar and any supplied conditions, then play it through the selected media players.

strategy.name: Selection strategy
strategy.description: Fixed uses fixed_asset_id when supplied; random chooses a matching hymn; sequential cycles through matching hymns while the engine is running.

fixed_asset_id.name: Fixed asset ID
fixed_asset_id.description: Exact hymn asset ID for fixed selection.

category_ids.name: Category IDs
category_ids.description: Restrict selection to category IDs such as marian or eucharistic.

feast_ids.name: Feast IDs
feast_ids.description: Require a matching LitCal feast, then restrict selection to those feast tags.

offices.name: Office IDs
offices.description: Restrict selection to hymns tagged for matins, lauds, daytime, vespers, or compline.

seasons.name: Season IDs
seasons.description: Require a matching liturgical season, then restrict selection to those season tags.

rank.name: Liturgical rank
rank.description: Require a matching LitCal rank, such as solemnity, feast, or memorial.

canonical_hours.name: Canonical hours
canonical_hours.description: Prefer these Liturgy of the Hours contexts while selecting. This is not a clock-time trigger.

seed.name: Seed
seed.description: Make a random candidate choice reproducible for the same date and request.

recent_exclusion.name: Recent exclusion
recent_exclusion.description: For unseeded non-automatic selection, avoid this many recent selections when enough hymns are available.

date.name: Liturgical date
date.description: Liturgical date in YYYY-MM-DD form to evaluate instead of today.
